set.body:
Goal: preserve tracker-generated evidence and experiment messages without conflating their meanings.

Acceptance criteria:
- SFIX/EFIX, SSACC/ESACC, SBLINK/EBLINK and every declared supported native record retain eye, interval, summary fields, raw provenance, and source location.
- Native events have a vendor-algorithm identity and cannot inhabit DetectionResult without an explicit adapter and provenance.
- MSG records retain logged timestamp, optional vendor offset, effective observed timestamp, and exact payload.
- Experiment messages materialize only into ObservedTimeline; planned timestamps are never fabricated.
- Calibration, validation, drift-correction, Data Viewer integration, recording, system, and unknown messages are preserved as typed or native metadata.
- Numeric-leading payloads, offsets, simultaneous messages, and malformed event pairs have reference-backed tests.
- Blink event intervals may inform sample validity through an explicit reconciliation policy; missing samples alone never prove Blink.
set.title: Parse EyeLink native events, messages, and tracker metadata
